📰 General

Minneapolis Residents Detail Daily Fear and Uncertainty Amidst ICE Presence •

Residents of Minneapolis are sharing firsthand accounts of their daily lives impacted by the presence of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers. Individuals describe a persistent atmosphere of fear and anxiety stemming from potential encounters with ICE agents. Several residents recounted instances of heightened vigilance and altered routines due to the perceived threat. These experiences highlight the ongoing tension between local communities and federal immigration enforcement.

🌍 World

Russian Forces Recruiting Ukrainian Teens for Sabotage Operations, Reports Reveal •

Ukrainian authorities are investigating reports that Russian forces are recruiting teenagers to carry out sabotage missions within Ukraine. The recruitment efforts reportedly target young individuals struggling with unemployment and lacking opportunities. These teens are being trained and deployed to conduct covert operations, primarily in the Mykolaiv region. Investigations are ongoing to determine the full scale of the operation and identify those involved.

🦅 US

Disney Afternoon Collection Finally Arrives on Nintendo Switch eShop •

The Disney Afternoon Collection, previously unavailable on the Nintendo Switch, has been released on the eShop. The collection includes the original titles from 1993 and 1994, featuring games like Mickey's Christmas Carol and Gumby’s Animal Kingdom. ESRB rating information triggered the listing’s appearance. The collection offers a nostalgic trip for fans of the classic Disney animated series.

💰 Business

Carvana Stock Plummets as Short Seller Attacks Related-Party Deals •

Carvana’s stock price dropped 11% on Wednesday following a critical report from short seller Gotham City Research. The report focused on concerns surrounding related-party transactions within the company’s family-controlled group. Gotham City Research questioned the financial arrangements, alleging potential manipulation of valuations. This scrutiny has triggered a significant sell-off of Carvana shares, reflecting investor concerns about the company’s financial practices.

💻 Technology

Samsung Unveils Magnetic Charging Puck for Galaxy S26 Series – Qi2 Standard Confirmed •

Samsung has released images of its new 25-watt magnetic charging puck designed specifically for the upcoming Galaxy S26 series. The accessory utilizes the Qi2 wireless charging standard, which incorporates magnets for improved alignment and connection. Samsung’s design confirms the series’ support for this new charging technology. The puck offers fast wireless charging capabilities for compatible devices.

🎭 Entertainment

Kanye West Announces ‘Bully’ Album Release Date, Partners with Gamma Records •

Rapper Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, has confirmed a March 20th release date for his upcoming album, “Bully.” The project marks his 12th studio album and is being distributed through a new partnership with the independent music company, Gamma Records. Details regarding the album’s tracklist and overall sound remain undisclosed at this time. This release follows a period of relative silence from the artist.

🏅 Sports

Bills Hire Joe Brady as Head Coach, Seeking to Build on Past Success •

The Buffalo Bills have appointed Joe Brady as their new head coach following the departure of Sean McDermott. Brady’s hiring represents an attempt to replicate the team’s previous success under McDermott, which included multiple playoff appearances. The organization is aiming to leverage Brady’s experience to continue building upon the Bills’ recent achievements. Details regarding Brady’s specific responsibilities and the team’s strategic approach are yet to be fully outlined.

🔬 Science

NASA’s Curiosity Rover Unearths Intriguing Coral-Like Formation on Mars •

NASA’s Curiosity rover recently identified a small, coral-shaped rock formation on Mars, documented in an image taken in July 2023. The formation, measuring approximately one inch in width, exhibits geological features suggesting it originated billions of years ago. Scientists believe the structure offers valuable insights into the planet’s ancient past and potential habitability. Analysis of the rock’s composition and shape is ongoing to determine its precise origin and significance.

🩺 Health

New Study Links Gut Bacteria to Increased Risk of Alzheimer’s Disease •

Researchers at the University of Minnesota have identified a specific gut bacteria composition that correlates with an elevated risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease. The study, published in Alzheimer’s & Dementia, analyzed the gut microbiome of over 150 individuals, comparing those with and without the disease. Participants with a higher abundance of Desulfovibrio bacteria exhibited a significantly increased risk of cognitive decline. Scientists believe this bacteria may contribute to inflammation in the brain, a known factor in Alzheimer’s progression.
